title: If the provisions of section 435K are 435K The owner, skipper, tindal
text:
137E. If the provisions of section 435K are 435K The owner, skipper, tindal

contravened. or any other person in

charge of the Indian fishing
boat shall be liable to fine
which may extend to one
thousand rupees and in
addition to fine which may
extend to fifty rupees for
every day during which the
offence continues after

conviction.
